subject: general
question: In November 2022, Pradhan Mantri National Apprenticeship Mela held in _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**197**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Pradhan Mantri National Apprenticeship Mela (PMNAM) was held on December 12th in 197 Districts across India.
 
• Various companies participated in the Event.
 
• During the event candidates who have passed classes 5 -12 and have skill training certificates, and ITI Diploma holders may apply.
 
• The event is being used as a platform to boost institutions' and students' participation. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The event witnessed the participation of various companies from different sectors.
 
• Participating companies will have the chance to meet potential apprentices on a single platform, and give applicants a chance to work with them.
 
• Pradhan Mantri National Apprenticeship Mela is being used as a platform to boost institutions' and students' participation.
 
• Additionally, it informs young people about the variety of options offered by the partnering businesses.
